# Changelog

## 0.1.0-alpha.2 — 2026-07-23

- Requires BBK `0.1.0-alpha.4` and declares `implementation_structure.status = supported`.
- Added deterministic `structure`, `slice`, `inventory`, and `structure-review` entrypoints.
- Added Go-namespaced structure, slice, actual-inventory, planned/actual comparison, and review-result schemas.
- Added Go type-driven structure authoring and focused structure review skills.
- Added package, API, state, goroutine, channel, context, effect, recovery, module-release, CGO, and touchpoint projections.
- Added proportional structure/slice mappings and seven non-executing gate recipes.
- Added alpha.4 positive, negative, unsupported, foundation, legacy, and planned/actual fixtures.
- Added OMP tools and commands for structure, slice, and structure review.
- Preserved alpha.1 preflight, routing, gates, installer, and ordinary minimal-resolution behavior.

## 0.1.0-alpha.1 — 2026-07-23

- Initial comprehensive-alpha Go profile for BBK alpha.3.

## 0.1.0-alpha.3 — 2026-07-24

Added typed State–Decision–Effect and Review Assurance dispatch, mappings, schemas, fixtures, OMP surfaces, migration guidance, and release qualification while preserving alpha.2 skill bytes and legacy interfaces.
